title: Finite-support two-sided Duhamel history bound from the full Q3 character envelope
question: Can the registered full Q3 static second-commutator envelope be inserted into an exact finite-member two-sided Duhamel remainder estimate for a fixed two-site configuration-character word while keeping product, modular and shape costs explicit?
method: Load the EXP-001152 complete kinetic-plus-force static second-commutator envelope and verify its registered finite periodic compact-source scope.
Recompute the two-site kinetic fourth-power support cost for amplitudes 1/4 and -1/3 using the commuting site-momentum inequality.
Use the complete registered force fourth bound with an explicit sqrt(G)<=G rational safety step and combine kinetic and force pieces by the Hilbert-space triangle inequality.
Insert the resulting finite-member squared coefficient into the exact positive- and negative-time second-order Duhamel kernel, then apply the full triangle bound to the two-orientation difference.
Recompute the bounded-C1 product same-form and cross-form costs from EXP-001150 without promoting them to unbounded history control, and reproduce every rational value independently and in Lean R323.
finding: Primary 21/21, independent 21/21, integrated 32/32, and Lean R323 compile PASS. The fixed two-site word has kinetic squared bound 1341774241/53747712, deliberately safe force squared bound 1553502726867294/5, and full squared static bound 83497217154884689002533/134369280. At T=1/3 each time orientation has squared remainder bound 83497217154884689002533/43535646720; the positive-minus-negative orientation difference has squared bound 83497217154884689002533/10883911680. The bounded-C1 product interface costs are 81/4 in the same form and 1701/4 in the cross form.
decision_reason: The complete EXP-001152 static envelope now has an explicit finite-time QFT-facing insertion for a fixed two-site configuration-character word. Both real-time signs and their triangle difference are computed exactly, so this is a genuine finite-member history seed. The safe force square-root step and the support cost are deliberately visible. Product costs are only the bounded-cylinder interface from EXP-001150, while modular derivatives, four-context factorial histories, volume comparison and all-shape limits remain unproved; no common-alpha or downstream QFT claim is licensed.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite-member two-sided Duhamel interface for one fixed two-site word. It does not prove a source-, cutoff-, beta- or volume-uniform direct Cauchy theorem, a modular derivative estimate, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production.
